input.scope: common_public island number tokens only; surrounding hands/cards ignored

shared.prompt: Locate visible circular number tokens lying on the hexagonal terrain tiles in this photo. Return one item for each separately visible physical token, not one item per category. Read only the numeral printed on each token; use null when it is not legible. Ignore cards, dice, pip dots, table decorations and spare pieces. Do not infer any missing token, expected count, legal game value, owner or board slot. Return only a JSON object with an items array; each item has bbox_2d and text. bbox_2d is [left,top,right,bottom] in relative image coordinates from 0 to 1000, not pixels. Only include a token when its own box can be localized; an unreadable numeral may still have a box. text must be the literal digit string or JSON null, never an explanation. An empty items array is allowed.
